answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 33123 Country: Bangladesh Title: Dua after salat Question: Most of the Bangladeshi mosque people make their dua (prayer) after performing their salah. And imam make dua with all. Some people think that it is a part of salah. I want to know that what is the system of dua after salah? Please inform me. May Allah help us. Answer ID: 33123 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1286/809/D=1432) It is proved from hadith to supplicate after fardh salah. Its virtues too have been mentioned in hadith, but it is not part of salah. If someone stands without supplicating or winds up his dua earlier it is allowable. However, one should not do long dua after those salah that are followed by sunnah rather it should be too short. Also, it is better to supplicate silently, sometime one or two words should be loud by which the purpose is to draw the attention of people towards it or teaching them, then there is no harm. Hence, it is against sunnah to do long dua after salah as well as to ban loud dua. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
